The plate is a square plate, roughly 26 cm across. It holds about 10 watermelon cubes, 4 pineapple pieces, and 3 honeydew pieces.

Each watermelon cube is about 2.5 cm, which is roughly 15-20 g, so 10 cubes come to about 170 g.
The pineapple pieces are about 20 g each, so 4 pieces come to about 80 g.
The honeydew pieces are about 25 g each, so 3 pieces come to about 70 g.

The total is about 320 g.

Energy: watermelon at 0.3 kcal/g gives about 51 kcal. Pineapple at 0.5 kcal/g gives about 40 kcal. Honeydew at 0.36 kcal/g gives about 25 kcal. The total is about 116 kcal.
